=={{header|ghul}}==

<syntaxhighlight lang="ghul">
use IO.Std.write_line;

female(n: int) -> int => if n == 0 then 1 else n - male(female(n - 1)) fi;

male(n: int) -> int => if n == 0 then 0 else n - female(male(n - 1)) fi;

show(name: string, f: (int) -> int) is
    let line = System.Text.StringBuilder();

    line.append(name);

    for n in 0..20 do
        line.append(" ");
        line.append(f(n));
    od

    write_line(line.to_string());
si

show("F:", female);
show("M:", male);
</syntaxhighlight>

{{out}}
<pre>
F: 1 1 2 2 3 3 4 5 5 6 6 7 8 8 9 9 10 11 11 12
M: 0 0 1 2 2 3 4 4 5 6 6 7 7 8 9 9 10 11 11 12
</pre>
